SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '01' THEN yv.YRYC_USAGE END) AS "01U", SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '01' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) AS "01R", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '01' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '01' THEN yv.YRYC_TOTAL END)) * 100, 2) AS "01P",
SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '02' THEN yv.YRYC_USAGE END) AS "02U", SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '02' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) AS "02R", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '02' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '02' THEN yv.YRYC_TOTAL END)) * 100, 2) AS "02P",
SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '03' THEN yv.YRYC_USAGE END) AS "03U", SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '03' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) AS "03R", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '03' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '03' THEN yv.YRYC_TOTAL END)) * 100, 2) AS "03P",
SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '04' THEN yv.YRYC_USAGE END) AS "04U", SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '04' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) AS "04R", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '04' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '04' THEN yv.YRYC_TOTAL END)) * 100, 2) AS "04P",
SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '05' THEN yv.YRYC_USAGE END) AS "05U", SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '05' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) AS "05R", ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '05' THEN yv.YRYC_REMNDR END) / SUM(CASE WHEN e.dept_code = '05' THEN yv.YRYC_TOTAL END)) * 100, 2) AS "05P"
FROM yearly_vacation yv JOIN employee e ON yv.empl_no = e.empl_no WHERE e.dept_code IN ('01', '02', '03', '04', '05')
